name: graph_folded_features
description: GL-1: the passes no graph node made are folded, read-only nodes on the Graph tab's root canvas. The fixture's root holds no graph node; its rendering section's material pass forward_opaque and its present are drawn as folded nodes, with scene_color between them as a solid line: present's `input` names it (GL-1e; a line only the frame plan implies is dashed). A double-click looks inside forward_opaque: a render.material_pass and a draw_loop zone whose body draws each material (draw.material), which Studio builds and never writes. An edit tried there sends nothing and says so, with Expand to edit; the breadcrumb comes back out; and the Frame Plan's Open in Graph on forward_opaque selects its node on the Graph canvas. The document is the same at the end.
